register: # SOURCE: ABB/FIMER 'Modbus RTU Register Map - Version Gt03.0, TRIO-50.0/60.0-TL-OUTD / TRIO-TM-50.0-400 / TRIO-TM-60.0-480 (rev 3.4, 2019)' (vendor document). ABB's tables give 1-based Modbus Data Addresses and state that the PDU address on the wire is one less, so every CSV register here is the table address minus 1 (each note shows the table address).
# APPLIES TO: TRIO-TM-50.0-400 / TRIO-TM-60.0-480, which add DC inputs 2 and 3 (registers 1113-1118 and 1129-1134).

# FUNCTION CODES: measurements are input registers (FC04); the heartbeat and grid measures in the holding map are FC03. Controls and set points (holding 180-227, 501-516, 801-802, 1006-1007) are writable in the inverter but deliberately not mapped here.

# BYTE ORDER: ABB 'Byte order: Big-endian'. U32 counters are high register first (the app default). Floats are ABB's 'SF32' = Word Swapped Floating Point (low register first), so each float row carries Register_Endian little_endian-CDAB. ABB's example: output power 20000 W is returned as registers 0x4000 0x469C.

note: table 300; increments every second, wraps at 65535
table 301; IEEE-754 float, word-swapped (low register first). Returns 0xFFFFFFFF if the inverter does not support it.
table 303; IEEE-754 float, word-swapped (low register first).
table 305; IEEE-754 float, word-swapped (low register first).
table 307; IEEE-754 float, word-swapped (low register first).
